caption: The video captures an extreme close-up view of water droplets clinging to a wet, transparent glass surface set against a bright, out-of-focus white and grey background. The field is densely populated with stationary droplets of varying sizes, each reflecting a small, dark crescent of light. A faint vertical water streak runs down the center-left of the frame, while a diagonal streak cuts through the lower-left corner. A thin dark trail along the central vertical streak lengthens downward as a droplet slides slowly, leaving a darker wet path behind it. Simultaneously, another thin dark trail along the lower-left diagonal streak grows steadily downward, marking the progress of a second droplet running down the glass. The vast majority of the surrounding droplets remain fixed in position and shape, while subtle shifts in reflections accompany the moving water.
